# Navorika - 100+ Free Online Tools

Navorika is a free portal for browser-based calculators, PDF utilities, image tools, developer utilities, and construction calculators. Tool pages include plain-language instructions, formulas or processing details, limitations, and related resources where relevant.

## Key Features
- 100+ free online tools
- Local browser processing for supported tools
- Clear privacy information on each tool page
- No signup required
- Works on all devices

## Tool Categories
- PDF Tools: Merge, split, compress, and convert PDF documents
- Image Tools: Resize, compress, crop, and convert images
- Finance Calculators: SIP, EMI, GST, tax, PPF, FD calculators
- Health Calculators: BMI, BMR, TDEE, body fat, fitness calculators
- Developer Tools: Base64, JWT, JSON, QR code generators
- Construction Calculators: Concrete, cement, brick, steel weight calculators
